text:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync: need final region-specific power/thermal constraints for H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi + preferred announcement cadence. Can we lock this today?

Sam (hw-ops): Lab snap: H200 BIOS v2.4 drops peak ~7%, but a subset of racks still show sustained throttling under 6h loads. Logs: /lab/thermal/2026-03-18.

Jo (marketplace): Marketplace constraint: image tags & SKU metadata required 72h pre-soft-announce. We can stage hidden SKUs if regions slip. Also need a health-check endpoint for canaries.

Ken (platform): Recommend NA -> EU -> APAC rollout with 24h canary windows. I'll add a routing rule to fallback to q8 model variant on sustained thermal events.

Sam (hw-ops): Quick table:
```
H100: BIOS1.9 | peak 640W | sustained 510W
H200: BIOS2.4 | peak 710W | sustained 600W
MI300: FW3.2 | peak 690W | sustained 570W
Gaudi: revB  | peak 410W | sustained 350W
```

Maya (partnerships): Proposed announce: NA Apr 9 (soft), EU Apr 11, APAC Apr 14. Jo, can you stage hidden SKUs and confirm health URLs?

Jo (marketplace): Will do. Need final tag names and a health-check path. I'll prepare a visibility toggle playbook.

Ken (platform): Routing thresholds: GPU power >92% for 2min OR temp >80C for 90s -> trigger fallback + page.

Sam (hw-ops): I'll validate thresholds in lab and upload results. Will also document fan-curve tweaks for APAC racks.

Maya (partnerships): Action items: Sam finalize BIOS cutoff + rollback, Jo stage SKUs + health checks, Ken add gating/fallback rule, Partnerships draft embargo text. Sync tomorrow 10:00 PT.

sync-bot: Calendar invite created: 2026-04-02 10:00 PT - https://calendar.redwood.example/ghi

Jo (marketplace): Acknowledged, will populate invite with checklist.
